reproduction_target: Comparative population-genomic reconstruction of the diploid parental origins and early genome stabilization of the allotetraploid Arabidopsis suecica. Computational target: short-read mapping of 16 A. suecica, 970 A. thaliana and 163 A. arenosa samples to the sub-genome-partitioned A. suecica reference (BWA-MEM), duplicate removal (samtools), GATK HaplotypeCaller SNP calling and custom variant filtration; ploidy inference (nQuire) and S-allele genotyping (NGSGenotyp); nucleotide diversity (pi) and Nei's D network (vcfR/StAMPP/tanggle/ggtree); ecological niche modelling of current and LGM climate (ModleR/maxent/raster + WorldClim + GBIF); SnpEff annotation, SNP polarization, a modified McDonald-Kreitman selection scan, GO enrichment (TopGO/biomaRt), homeolog loss-of-function pairing, two permutation tests (re-pairing and in-silico synthetic genomes), purifying-selection statistics, RagTag/Helixer/BLAST/AGAT/MAFFT/IQTree/snipit gene-family phylogenetics, mined expression log2FC re-analysis, and STRING MCL network clustering. Wet-lab herbarium DNA extraction and Illumina sequencing of 6 accessions are W (out of computational-reproduction scope).
granularity_note: Coarse one-step-per-named-tool/analysis, built from the biorxiv v2 JATS XML 'Materials and Methods' section (retrieved by curl; WebFetch of the .source.xml returned HTTP 403). Code availability names a single public GitHub path (github.com/burnsro/ArabidopsisSuecica/tree/main/origin) whose landing page shows only three python scripts (MKtest.py, Pi_1001_justtoAsuecica_fromCSV.py, Pi_AarenosaSubgenome.py) and a one-line README ('Code for A. suecica origin'). That repository therefore covers only the pi and MK-test steps; every other analysis step has no published code. Four tools carry exact prose version pins (BWA 0.7.17, samtools 1.10, GATK 3.8, SnpEff 5.2); all remaining tools and every R/python package are named without any version. No lockfile, container, conda spec or release tag is claimed anywhere.

steps.label: Wet-lab: herbarium DNA extraction (Moscow University Herbarium; PTB buffer, 37C overnight, Gutaker et al. 2017 protocol) for 5 A. arenosa + 1 A. suecica accession
Wet-lab: Illumina HiSeq 2000 library prep and 50-bp paired-end sequencing at Vienna BioCenter Core Facilities (VBCF)

Read mapping of 16 A. suecica, 970 A. thaliana, 163 A. arenosa short-read sets to the sub-genome-partitioned A. suecica chromosome-level assembly (Burns et al. 2021) using BWA-MEM version 0.7.17 with unpaired-read penalty set to 15
PCR duplicate removal with the samtools rmdup function, version 1.10
SNP calling with GATK version 3.8 HaplotypeCaller, gVCF merging via CombineGVCFs and GenotypeGVCFs — no non-default parameters or intervals stated

Variant filtration: bi-allelic-only, repeat/TE/centromere/rDNA masking, coverage window at +/-0.5x log median coverage, heterozygous-SNP removal (>5% frequency in A. thaliana/A. suecica; >90% of individuals in A. arenosa), missingness allowances (10% arenosa, 15% thaliana) — thresholds stated in prose, no script published, masking interval files not provided
Ploidy inference on raw fastq of the 5 herbarium A. arenosa individuals with nQuire ('denoised' function, 'lrdmodel'; max log-likelihood / lowest delta log-likelihood decision rule) — no version
S-allele genotyping from short reads with the NGSGenotyp pipeline against a database of known Arabidopsis SRK sequences (per Kolesnikova et al. 2023) — no version, database snapshot not provided

Pairwise nucleotide diversity (pi) of each A. thaliana accession / A. arenosa individual against the 16 A. suecica accessions, computed with the authors' custom python scripts published in the repo (Pi_1001_justtoAsuecica_fromCSV.py, Pi_AarenosaSubgenome.py) — no python or dependency version stated
Nei's D genetic distance for the mixed-ploidy dataset: VCF read into R with vcfR, distances computed with StAMPP — no R or package versions
Distance-network and map visualization with R packages tanggle, ggtree and ggspatial — no versions, no plotting scripts published

Ecological niche modelling with the ModleR R workflow + maxent: GBIF occurrences (8,451 records -> 1,772 georeferenced preserved specimens -> 483 deduplicated -> 197 after 0.5 km geo_filt thinning) supplemented with Novikova et al. 2017 records; 10,000 background points via setup_sdmdata; 19 WorldClim bioclim variables at 30 arc-seconds reduced to 8 uncorrelated; 5 partition types x 5 runs = 25 models; TSS threshold 0.7 (all models >0.9, all retained); projection to LGM climate — no package/maxent versions, no GBIF download DOI, no LGM GCM/scenario named, no random seed
Selection scan: modified McDonald-Kreitman test (Dn>Ds, Pn<Ps, Pn==0 in A. suecica) implemented in the published MKtest.py script — script public, no version or dependency pins
SNP annotation with SnpEff version 5.2 — annotation database build/version for the A. suecica reference not stated

SNP polarization and LoF selection: 200 genetically closest A. thaliana accessions polarize the A. arenosa sub-genome, 29 closest diploid A. arenosa polarize the A. thaliana sub-genome; high-effect SnpEff calls taken as predicted LoF; heterozygosity >1% excluded; 414 homeolog pairs retained with the highest-frequency LoF per homeolog — counts and rules stated, no code published

GO enrichment with the R package TopGO ('weight01' algorithm, Fisher p<0.05) on A. thaliana one-to-one orthologs; annotations pulled with biomaRt::useMart(biomart='plants_mart', dataset='athaliana_eg_gene', host='plants.ensembl.org') — no package versions and no Ensembl Plants release pinned (live remote query)

Permutation analyses: (a) 1,000 random re-pairings of the 414 LoF-carrying homeolog pairs; (b) 1,000 in-silico A. suecica genomes built by sampling with replacement from 200 A. thaliana and 29 diploid A. arenosa individuals, scored for dual-LoF occurrence — procedure described, no code, no RNG seeds
Purifying-selection statistics on CDS: pairwise pi and Pn/Ps per homeolog with pseudocount 0.1, one-sided paired t-test comparing intact vs LoF-carrying homeologs — no code, no software/version
A. arenosa assembly scaffolding with RagTag onto the A. lyrata NT1 assembly, followed by structural annotation with Helixer — no versions, no models/parameters stated
Protein BLAST of A. thaliana target-gene proteins against Helixer-annotated proteins extracted with AGAT — no versions, no BLAST e-value/identity thresholds

Gene-family alignment and phylogenetics: MAFFT L-INS-i alignment, IQTree trees with fast bootstrap = 1000, alignment visualization with snipit — no versions, substitution model / ModelFinder settings unstated
Single- vs multi-copy gene enrichment: gene sets from Z. Li et al. 2016, hypergeometric tests — no software named, no code

Expression-bias re-analysis: mined rosette log2FC estimates from Burns et al. 2021 (15 natural + 2 synthetic A. suecica lines), averaged per group, restricted to homeolog pairs with LoF frequency >=60% (64 intact homeologs: 16 arenosa-derived, 48 thaliana-derived) — no software named, no code

STRING protein-protein association network on selection-scan genes with MCL clustering, inflation parameter 2 (102 clusters, 4 examined) — STRING database version not pinned, web-service query, no code

headline.inference_inclusive_upper_bound: RI ceiling on 4/22 computational steps (C1 BWA-MEM 0.7.17, C2 samtools 1.10, C3 GATK 3.8, C12 SnpEff 5.2 — the only four exact prose version pins in the paper). The remaining 18/22 steps cap at NI because no version is given for nQuire, NGSGenotyp, RagTag, Helixer, BLAST, AGAT, MAFFT, IQTree, snipit, STRING, maxent/ModleR, or any R/python package (vcfR, StAMPP, tanggle, ggtree, ggspatial, raster, TopGO, biomaRt), nor for R or python themselves. The published code (3 python scripts) covers only the pi and MK-test steps; all other steps would have to be reconstructed from prose. No lockfile, container digest, conda spec, or release tag is claimed, so even under stage-2 execution no step could exceed RI without an executed environment capture.
headline.coverage: 22 computational analysis steps assessed from the biorxiv v2 JATS 'Materials and Methods'. 2 wet-lab steps (herbarium DNA extraction, Illumina HiSeq 2000 sequencing at VBCF) counted in W and out of computational-reproduction scope. Coverage = 22/24 (92%) of enumerated steps.

gaps.missing: The repository is live (HTTP 200) but contains only three python scripts (MKtest.py, Pi_1001_justtoAsuecica_fromCSV.py, Pi_AarenosaSubgenome.py) with a one-line README. There is no release tag, no DOI archive, and no run instructions.
